name: Pipeliners - Three Page Audit 2026-09-26
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-09-26

# Summary
"Buckeye, Maricopa and cast iron post: why they rank where they do", an HTML audit prepared Sep 26, 2026 with GSC data through Sep 23 (Domain property UI, Jun 24 to Sep 23). Nothing was deployed; two of the three pages counted as ad-touched under the Sep 23 rule.

# Key findings
- Biggest finding: Google had not indexed most recent work. /buckeye/ was last crawled Aug 28, and Google's copy still had the old title and meta, so the Aug 31 title, Sep 1 rewrite and Sep 15 pipe-break section were not yet seen. The cast iron post was last crawled Aug 24. Maricopa was recrawled Sep 25.
- This overturned the earlier conclusion that the Buckeye rewrite cost its page-1 "buckeye pipe break repair" ranking.
- /buckeye/: 1 click, 2,020 impressions, position 22.2; demand is pipe breaks and water lines at positions 12 to 28; weak internal links.
- /maricopa/: 1 click, 430 impressions, position 23.9; title says trenchless sewer but the H1 and headings say something else; unverified warranty and service claims.
- /how-long-do-cast-iron-pipes-last/: 0 clicks, 133 impressions, position 60.8; 120 of 133 impressions came in its first five weeks; thin next to pages that rank.

# Decisions and status
- Levers: get Buckeye's current page indexed then fill water line gaps; align Maricopa's H1 and add an answer block; deepen the cast iron post with sourced numbers, photos and an author, then request indexing.
- The report also has a cross-page check, an action plan, tracking and a list of client information needed.
